name: dead-listeners
method: Listed every add_action/add_filter on a hook starting with 'mvs_' inside Free includes/. Compared each against do_action/apply_filters call sites in Free includes/ + templates/ + src/, plus Pro includes/. Skipped WP/BP/WC core hooks, skipped wp_ajax_/admin_post_/rest_api_init/init/etc. Skipped hooks scheduled via Action Scheduler (as_enqueue_async_action) since the cron runner fires them.

result.evidence: No do_action('mvs_share_recorded') anywhere in Free includes/, templates/, src/, or Pro includes/. ShareService::record() does not fire it; the new POST /media/{id}/share REST endpoint (1.2.0) updates mvs_media_stats.shares directly without firing this hook either.
fix_options: A) Fire mvs_share_recorded in MediaController::record_share() + ShareService::record() so the cache is invalidated when share count changes.
B) Drop the listener (cache will go stale on shares; share count is not displayed prominently in Free).

result.evidence: No do_action('mvs_reaction_removed') anywhere. ReactionService::remove() returns silently. ReactionController::delete_item() also does not fire it. mvs_reaction_added IS fired (twice — service + controller) but the symmetric remove hook is missing.
result.fix: Add do_action('mvs_reaction_removed', $media_id, $user_id, $reaction_type) in ReactionService::remove() (after successful $wpdb->delete) and in ReactionController::delete_item() (after successful service call). Mirrors the mvs_reaction_added pattern at ReactionService.php:100 + ReactionController.php:184. Without it, the cache for media stats stays stale when a reaction is removed — the count in CacheService is wrong until another invalidating event fires.

result.evidence: No do_action('mvs_media_moderated') anywhere. ModerationController::approve_item / reject_item write directly to mvs_media_index.moderation_status without firing the hook. ModerationService::handle_flagged() listens to mvs_media_flagged (which IS fired) but doesn't re-fire mvs_media_moderated either.
result.fix: Fire do_action('mvs_media_moderated', $media_id, $action) in ModerationController::approve_item and ::reject_item (and any direct moderation_status writes). Two real consumers waiting: cache invalidation + outbound webhooks. The outbound webhook for moderation events is silently broken in production today.

notes: All 3 listeners are real dead listeners. mvs_reaction_removed and mvs_media_moderated are pre-existing (not 1.2.0 regressions) but worth surfacing because mvs_media_moderated has both a cache and an outbound webhook consumer — outbound webhooks for moderation are silently dropped today. mvs_share_recorded is an organic miss from the new 1.2.0 record_share endpoint. Skipped from results: mvs_ai_process_media + mvs_deliver_webhook listeners (these are scheduled via as_enqueue_async_action — Action Scheduler fires them, so they are NOT dead). Skipped from results: BP/WP/admin_post_/wp_ajax_ hooks (out of scope per cache spec).
